name: dsh-chapters-ci-host-lock
description: Hermetic install manifest for the DSH host the e2e boots spawn. The host version ALONE is not reproducible: its caret ranges float, and @deepseek-ai/dsh-base rc.2 -> rc.3 (published 2026-09-22) changed system-prompt bytes every model tape depends on. This lock was resolved with --before=2026-09-14T18:51:00Z (the working install's date), pinning the whole closure. pnpm is installed in a SEPARATE prefix (a second root in one transaction re-deduces and breaks the host closure; its version never touches model bytes).
